propositions: The webhook and rerun endpoints accept the shared authentication token as a query parameter, causing it to be logged in plaintext by uvicorn's default access log to stderr and journald.

The webhook token is the same as GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN (the bot's Gerrit credential) when WEBHOOK_TOKEN is not explicitly configured, making the logged secret a compromise of both endpoints and Gerrit access.
The token is exposed in a fail-open manner with no error or alarm, so the exposure is silent and undetected until logs are grepped or shared.

The fix moves the token out of the query string to the X-Rebar-Token HTTP header (which uvicorn does not log) and installs a TokenRedactingFilter as a backstop to redact any remaining token references from access logs.
The previously-logged token must be rotated and the rotation tracked separately before this code change is deployed, otherwise the new token is logged on first use.
